name: LitBench
description: LitBench is the first standardized benchmark for creative writing evaluation, comprising a held-out test set of 2,480 debiased, human-labeled story comparisons and a training corpus of 43,827 pairwise human preference labels. Stories are drawn from Reddit with an average length of 550 words.
reputation: First standardized creative writing verification benchmark; identifies Claude-3.7-Sonnet as strongest off-the-shelf judge at 73% human agreement
notes: Bradley-Terry and Generative reward models achieve 78% accuracy, outperforming all off-the-shelf LLM judges; test set contains 3,543 total stories across 2,480 pairwise comparisons.
